description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component named HomeCard, which displays different types of content cards for a TV application. It includes two variants: a default poster card and a TV channel card, each with specific layout, styling, and accessibility considerations. The file also manages focus states and semantic roles for accessibility.

classes.name: HomeCardVariant
classes.description: Enumeration for specifying the variant/layout of the HomeCard component, either Default or TvChannel.

methods.name: HomeCard
methods.description: Main composable function that renders a content card based on the specified variant and parameters.

methods.name: DefaultPosterCard
methods.description: Composable for rendering a default poster style card with image, progress bar, and title.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Composable for rendering a TV channel style card with poster, info column, live badge, progress, and optional channel icon.
